PUT /api/v1/auth/change-password.summary: Đổi mật khẩu và thu hồi toàn bộ phiên cũ

PUT /api/v1/admin/workflows/{id}/graph.summary: Replace draft graph atomically; rollback on validation failure

DELETE /api/v1/admin/system-settings/{id.summary: Remove an override; application property becomes the fallback

DELETE /api/v1/admin/shifts/{shiftId}.summary: Delete an unstarted PLANNED Shift; active/history shifts are retained

POST /api/v1/robots/{id}/provision-secre.description: Secret chỉ xuất hiện trong response này và được lưu dạng BCrypt hash

POST /api/v1/maps/{id}/activate.summary: Kích hoạt Map và vô hiệu Map active cũ trên cùng Floor

POST /api/v1/jobs/{jobId}/auth-verificat.description: ADMIN or STAFF owning/assigned to the RUNNING Job. Purpose must match the AUTHENTICATE Step. Only STAFF_CONFIRMATION is supported here; QR_CODE requires a separate proof verifier. Same actor retry returns the existing unexpired grant without extending its TTL. Scope violations return 403.

POST /api/v1/auth/login.summary: Đăng nhập tài khoản đã ACTIVE

POST /api/v1/admin/workflows/graph.summary: Create Workflow and complete graph atomically

POST /api/v1/admin/shifts.summary: Create a planned Shift and its Slots atomically

POST /api/v1/admin/operations/retention/.summary: Run retention; dry-run is the safe default

POST /api/v1/admin/monitoring/heatmaps.summary: Store a generated heatmap; does not run an AI algorithm

POST /api/v1/admin/accounts/{accountId}/.summary: Admin reset mật khẩu và thu hồi toàn bộ phiên

GET /api/v1/staff/me.summary: Lấy Account, StaffProfile và ca trực đang hiệu lực của Staff hiện tại

GET /api/v1/admin/reports/overview.summary: Get job, robot, request, alert and emergency overview

GET /api/v1/admin/reports/jobs.summary: Drill down into jobs used by analytics

GET /api/v1/admin/reports/jobs/export.cs.summary: Export a bounded, audited job report as CSV
